The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Incorrect phrase: “他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩” Formula: 跟 + person + 一起 + verb; 模仿 + activity / 玩 + game Correct: “他常常跟朋友们一起模仿祭拜。” “祭拜” is not normally followed by “玩.” In this story, Mencius imitates the funeral rituals, so “模仿祭拜” is clearer.
